all_words.explanation: Integrity means moral consistency and honesty, which is one of the core virtues in classical ethics, so the link is semantic.
Gravel is loose stone used in road building and has no connection to moral character.
Courage is one of the classical cardinal virtues discussed in ethical philosophy, so it belongs to the same thematic field.
A thermometer measures temperature and has nothing to do with ethics or character.
Temperance, the moderation of desires, is itself a classical virtue, so the link is semantic.
A canoe is a small boat and is unrelated to moral philosophy.

explanation: The associated words are themselves moral virtues from classical ethics, while the others belong to road building, measurement, and boats.
